summary.request: We defer subscription revenue on sales invoices with deferral templates. Finance wants every G/L entry of the invoice, including each monthly deferral release, to carry the Contract No. from the sales header and a Recognition Month (YYYY-MM) showing the month the amount is recognised. Some contracts need their own number of months, so sales lines created by our contract import must get a schedule with the contract's period count.
summary.business-process: Carry a sales header Contract No. and a per-period Recognition Month to every G/L entry of a sales invoice, including deferral releases posted by Gen. Jnl.-Post Line, and give contract-imported sales lines a deferral schedule with the contract's period count (sales posting, invoice posting buffer, deferrals).

lifecycle.step: Classify Contract No. as CustomerContent on every table that holds it; Recognition Month as CustomerContent on G/L Entry; Contract No. of Periods as CustomerContent.
Ship permission set Contract Deferral with execute on Contract G/L Posting and Contract Deferral Schedule.
No back-fill: G/L entries posted before installation keep blank Contract No. and Recognition Month unless the open question decides otherwise. Posted entries are never modified to fill them.

tests.given: Customer, G/L accounts and a 3-period straight-line deferral template created with Library codeunits; sales invoice with Contract No. and one line using the template.
tests.then: Every G/L entry with the posted Document No. (revenue, receivables, VAT, deferral transfer and each release) has the Contract No.; each deferral release entry, on both the G/L account and deferral account side, has Recognition Month equal to the YYYY-MM of its own posting date, and the three months differ.

tests.given: Sales invoice with Contract No. and no deferral.
tests.then: The receivables G/L entry and the revenue G/L entry carry Contract No.; Recognition Month equals the posting month.

tests.given: Sales invoice with Contract No. and two lines on different G/L accounts, one deferred and one not.
tests.then: All G/L entries of both buffer groups carry the same Contract No.

tests.when: The invoice is posted, and separately the document is archived.
tests.then: Sales Invoice Header and Sales Header Archive carry the Contract No.

tests.given: Deferral template with 12 periods; sales line created by the contract import procedure with a contract period count of 5.
tests.when: SetContractSchedule runs, then Quantity is validated to a new value.
tests.then: Deferral Header No. of Periods is 5 after both steps, and the Deferral Line total equals the new Amount to Defer.

tests.given: Sales invoice line with a contract schedule of 5 periods.
tests.then: Five deferral release pairs are posted, each with Contract No. and its own Recognition Month.

tests.given: Sales line with Contract No. of Periods = 5 and a contract schedule; header Posting Date then changed so Deferral Code is re-validated with the template's 12 periods.
tests.when: Posting preview and posting are run.
tests.then: Both stop with the schedule-mismatch error and no G/L entries exist; after re-running SetContractSchedule posting succeeds.

open-questions.question: Does the contract import app already define Contract No. on Sales Header (with which field number, type and length)? If so, the new tables must mirror that definition and the Sales Header extension is dropped.
Should Contract No. also be mirrored on the posted shipment, credit memo, return receipt and archive tables (designed by default), or only on the posted invoice?
Should Contract No. also be stored on Cust. Ledger Entry (the journal line already carries it)?

Must Contract No. and Recognition Month appear as native filterable columns on General Ledger Entries (stored fields, designed), or is a related table keyed by Entry No. acceptable to avoid the G/L Entry extension cost?
Which Recognition Month should non-deferred entries carry (receivables, VAT, non-deferred revenue, and the initial transfer to the deferral account)? Designed: the month of the entry's posting date.

Do credit memos with deferrals and general journal deferrals also need Contract No. and Recognition Month? General journals use their own events (OnPostDeferralOnBeforeInsertGLEntryDeferralLineForGLAccount / ...ForDeferralAccount), not designed now.
Where does the import read the contract's period count, start date and calculation method (straight-line assumed), and which object performs the import?
Must already-posted invoices get Contract No. and Recognition Month? Only through a supported mechanism; otherwise history stays blank.
Are invoices posted with a payment method that has a balancing account, creating an extra payment journal line whose G/L entries must also carry Contract No.?
Is this the base-application deferral feature only, or are some invoices created by the Subscription Billing app?
